stages.notes: Quantities and rates are kept, not just totals, so every report figure traces to its line items.

fields.label: Material cost
fields.help: The material lines below, added up.

fields.label: Labour cost
fields.help: The labour lines below, added up.

fields.label: Total cost
fields.help: Derived from the costs above.

fields.label: Amount
fields.help: Derived as quantity × rate.

fields.label: Amount
fields.help: Derived as persons × days × rate.

stages.title: Workshop Outcomes, Problems & Feedback
stages.purpose: Outcomes, problems, and what the artisans and designer say.
stages.notes: Design and prototype counts come from your records. An override replaces a derived number and needs a reason, printed beneath it in the report.

fields.label: Number of designs (override)
fields.help: Leave blank to count the sketches recorded.

fields.label: Number of prototypes (override)
fields.help: Leave blank to count the prototypes recorded.

fields.label: Reason for the override
fields.help: Required if either count above is filled in.
fields.details: Printed under the headline figure, beside the number.

stages.title: Inspection & Closing
stages.purpose: The closing session, certificates issued and the inspecting officer's remarks.

fields.label: Signature
fields.help: Sign on the pad, or attach a photo of the signed sheet.
fields.details: Attendance is recorded by the fields above and isn’t held up by this.

stages.title: Report Generation & Submission
stages.purpose: Pick the template and contents, generate the report, and keep every file.
stages.notes: This stage sets up the report and does not appear in it. Every export is listed below with its checksum, so a submitted file can be matched to its record.

fields.label: Report colour
fields.help: Twelve colours that stay distinct on a black-and-white printer.
fields.details: Choose “Custom colour” to use the picker.

fields.label: Report colour (hex)
fields.help: The accent as #RRGGBB; leave blank for the template’s own colour.
fields.details: Filled in when a named colour is chosen. Headings, table headers, rules and figures all derive from it.

fields.label: Report typeface
fields.help: Applies to the Word document.
fields.details: The PDF uses a standard typeface that prints Odia, Devanagari and the rupee sign correctly.

fields.label: Report title
fields.help: Leave blank to use the workshop title.

fields.label: Organisation line
fields.help: Printed above the title on the cover.

fields.label: Append the recordings’ transcripts
fields.help: Adds an annexure with every transcript the workshop collected.

fields.label: Stages to leave out
fields.help: Stage keys omitted from this report.

fields.label: SHA-256
fields.help: Lets a submitted file be matched against this record.

fields.label: Generated on device
fields.help: True when the phone made the file with no network.

stages.title: Data Quality & Archive
stages.purpose: Confirm the record and media are preserved, and note photo quality problems.
stages.notes: Photos are checked for blur, low resolution, duplicates and missing views as they are taken; judge exposure and subject by eye. Rows here are entered by hand — tick “Detected automatically” for the ones the app raised.

stages.title: Post-Workshop Follow-up
stages.purpose: Whether designs were taken up: what is made, what sold, what artisans still need.
stages.notes: One record per product per monitoring interval, so design survival can be compared across workshops. Not needed to close the workshop — follow-up comes months later.
